checks: Fixed asset revision and scoped idempotent session creation
Invalid seek preserves generation; only one lease-bound stream may open
One continuous generation decodes at the requested duration as fMP4 with video, audio and visible caption glyphs
HTTP client disconnect cancels its generation, records PREVIEW_DISCONNECTED and reaps FFmpeg
Presentation telemetry alone sets pause anchor; old generation rejects control and stream
Head edit leaves fixed revision intact; events distinguish production and presentation
Active owner blocks takeover; release rotates lease and rejects old controls
Stop cancels producer and rejects another stream
SIGKILL restart reclaims stale private input while preserving another live host lease
SIGTERM reaps preview inputs and FFmpeg; restart terminates ephemeral session

environment.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 8.1.2 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers

scope: 60-second synthetic 320x180/25 fps video plus 48 kHz audio over the full HTTP session path; transfer/decode/cleanup smoke, not live 60-second playback, human media or a p50/p95 performance baseline.
